description: Protected, immutable copy of the epoch-39 checkpoint that produced the real oil-tiles-only IoU=0.1057 baseline number (re-verified in Phase 0 as 0.1074 at threshold 0.35 using a from-scratch, unit-tested metric implementation -- see docs/metric_audit.md). The original source file is untouched at data/processed/checkpoints/latest_unet_resnet18_epoch39_backup.pt (gitignored, local-only). This copy exists so Experiment 01+ always has a known-good, never-overwritten reference point, independent of whatever the top-level best_unet_resnet18.pt currently points to (which has since moved on to epoch 44+ under the LR-scheduler continuation run).
note_on_raw_val_dice: This metric is now known to be structurally unreliable -- see docs/metric_audit.md, Metric 1. It is recorded here only for provenance (it's what the original training loop reported), not as evidence of quality. The real oil-IoU numbers below are what actually matters.

phase0_reverification.script: scripts/evaluate.py + scripts/sweep_threshold.py, run against this exact checkpoint

training_configuration._provenance_note: Reconstructed from src/detection/train.py, scripts/train_detection.py, and LOG.md's 2026-08-25 'Real training run started' entry -- NOT guessed. Fields marked UNKNOWN could not be determined from any recorded source and must not be assumed.
training_configuration.script: scripts/train_detection.py (pre-Phase-1 version, no --lr/--channels CLI flags existed yet)
training_configuration.batch_size_selection: auto-probed by scripts/train_detection.py's probe_batch_size() from candidates [16, 8, 4]; LOG.md confirms 16 was selected (3235MB peak VRAM)
training_configuration.pos_weight_source: empirical, from scripts/compute_mask_class_balance.py's real oil-pixel fraction (2.98% mean) -- (1-0.0298)/0.0298 ~= 32.6
training_configuration.lr_scheduler: none active through epoch 39 -- ReduceLROnPlateau was only added AFTER resuming from this exact checkpoint (2026-08-27 pivot, see LOG.md), so it played no part in reaching epoch 39

augmentation.train: augment=True (src/detection/augment.py: flips, 90-degree rotations, dB-space speckle jitter std=0.5, applied before normalization)

training_configuration.normalization: normalize_db_fixed: fixed clip to [-40, 10] dB then linear scale to [0,1] -- see docs/metric_audit.md Gate C.2/C.3 for the finding that this range under-utilizes Band 1's actual value distribution
training_configuration.seed: UNKNOWN / NEEDS VERIFICATION -- no global torch.manual_seed / np.random.seed / random.seed call exists anywhere in src/ or scripts/ (confirmed by direct grep). ZenodoTileDataset(seed=0) only seeds that dataset instance's own per-tile augmentation RNG, not DataLoader shuffling order, weight init, or CUDA nondeterminism. The original epoch-39 run is therefore NOT fully reproducible bit-for-bit even with identical code and data -- this is exactly the gap Phase 1's run_manifest.json + explicit seeding is meant to close going forward.
training_configuration.dataset_split: scripts/build_training_pool.py, VAL_FRACTION=0.15, SPLIT_SEED=0, stratified by class + oil-fraction quartile -- 2184 train / 386 val source images, 34940 train tiles / 6176 val tiles at 512px non-overlapping
training_configuration.resume_history: trained epoch-by-epoch via train()'s latest_checkpoint_path resume mechanism from epoch 1; num_workers was 0 for epoch 1 only (I/O-bound, 93min) then raised to 6 for all subsequent epochs (LOG.md 2026-08-25); epochs target was 30 initially, extended to 60 mid-run after real held-out eval showed continued improvement (LOG.md 2026-08-26/27) -- epoch 39 is a point partway through that extended run, not a run that was ever targeted to stop at exactly 39
